## Review checklist

- [ ] Relevant checks passed; skipped checks and limitations are recorded above.
- [ ] Existing browser data and backups remain compatible, or migration is documented.
- [ ] Affected keyboard, reduced-motion, and mobile behavior was checked or marked unverified.
- [ ] Necessary documentation was updated, and no credentials or personal task data were included.
